divergences.summary: validate and validateStrict take &str; the source's runtime checks for non-string arguments (which return false) cannot be expressed.
divergences.rationale: Idiomatic Rust API decided at the strategy gate: string parameters are &str, so a number, null, object or array cannot be passed. The cases exist only because JavaScript is dynamically typed.
divergences.approvedBy: strategy gate 2026-10-20: 'an idiomatic Rust API (Result for errors)'; scope gauntlet lists non-string arguments as out of scope

divergences.summary: compareVersions, compare and satisfies take &str; the source's TypeError paths for non-string versions, operators and ranges (including four V8-generated messages) cannot be reached.
divergences.rationale: Idiomatic Rust API decided at the strategy gate: string parameters are &str, so non-string values cannot be passed. The cases exist only because JavaScript is dynamically typed.
divergences.approvedBy: strategy gate 2026-10-20: 'an idiomatic Rust API (Result for errors)'; scope gauntlet lists non-string arguments as out of scope; unattended: edge-cmp-precedence-v1-before-v2 (compare('foo', 42, '>'), tagged nonstring) added on 2026-10-20 as the conservative choice: it passes a non-string v2, which the approved divergence covers; its id lacks 'nonstring', so the glob missed it. No behavior change.
